summary_en: Nojima authorized acquisition of up to 4.0 million shares (1.36% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of JPY 5.0 billion over the period from November 18, 2026 to November 17, 2027 via market purchases including ToSTNeT-3, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decisions on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 17, 2026, Nojima's board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 4.0 million shares of common stock, representing 1.36% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum outlay of JPY 5.0 billion. The acquisition will be conducted via market purchases including ToSTNeT-3 transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, over the twelve-month period from November 18, 2026 through November 17, 2027.

The company stated the purpose of the buyback is to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency while executing flexible capital policies in response to changing business conditions. The authorization comes following the completion on November 6, 2026 (settlement date basis) of a prior buyback program decided by the board on February 17, 2026.
